parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'run.started', workflow_key: 'incoming-detection', n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), n8n_workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: $workflow.name, trigger: $('Normalize message').first().json.trigger, status: 'RUNNING', user_email: $('Normalize message').first().json.user_email, correlation_id: $('Normalize message').first().json.correlation_id }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $('Normalize message').first().json;
return [{ json: { user_email: p.user_email, message: p.message } }];
